items.definition:
a period of time between two events or at which something happens
The train departs at regular intervals of 30 minutes.

a small paper or cardboard container
He bought a packet of crisps from the shop.

a path or track
We followed the narrow pathway through the woods.

a game played on horseback; a type of shirt
He wore a blue polo shirt to the party.

a person who presents a television or radio programme
The presenter introduced the next guest on the show.

a mark left on the skin or within body tissue where a wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely
He still has a scar on his knee from the accident.

the arrangement of seats or the act of providing seats
The seating arrangement for the wedding was carefully planned.

a sound reproduction system using two or more channels
He turned on the stereo to listen to music.

a book used as a standard work for the study of a particular subject
We need to buy a new textbook for our history class.

plants in general
The dense vegetation made it difficult to walk through the jungle.

a type of woven fabric with a short dense pile
The curtains were made of soft red velvet.

a person whose job is to keep or inspect financial accounts
My accountant helps me with my taxes every year.

a person with assets worth at least a billion pounds or dollars
The billionaire donated a large sum to charity.

the action of cancelling something
The flight cancellation caused a lot of inconvenience.

a stick used as an aid in walking or as a support
My grandfather uses a cane to help him walk.

a tall, evergreen coniferous tree
The chest was made of fragrant cedar wood.

a certificate awarded by an educational establishment to show that someone has successfully completed a course of study
She received her diploma after graduating from college.

a thin sheet of metal; a character who contrasts with another
Wrap the leftovers in aluminum foil.

a type of flower; the colored part of the eye
Her eyes have beautiful blue irises.

a bulletin issued regularly to members of a society or organization
I subscribe to their weekly newsletter.

the action of shipping goods; a consignment of goods
The next shipment of goods is expected tomorrow.

a layer of earth with grass
The football pitch had new turf laid.

very important person
The VIP guests were given special access.

a boat built by Noah
Noah built an ark to save his family and animals.

protective covering
Knights wore heavy armour in battle.

the smallest unit of a chemical element
An atom is made up of protons, neutrons, and electrons.

a homeless person; buttocks (informal)
He saw a bum sleeping on the park bench.

a signal for action
She took her cue from the director and started speaking.

a person of abnormally small stature
In fairy tales, dwarfs often live in mines.

a long formal dress
She wore a beautiful gown to the ball.

a covering or inner layer
She applied eyeliner to her upper lid.

a large structure with a square base and four triangular sides
We visited the ancient pyramids in Egypt.

an image of a computer screen
Please send me a screenshot of the error message.

a vehicle used for travel in space
The spacecraft launched successfully into orbit.

an optical instrument for viewing distant objects
He used a telescope to look at the stars.

a temporary employee; temperature
She's working as a temp at the office.

the state or quality of being thick
The thickness of the ice was dangerous.

a person who lives in a village
The villagers gathered in the square for the festival.

the state or experience of finding something funny or entertaining
He watched the children play with great amusement.

a person who fights with their fists for sport
The boxer trained hard for the championship fight.

an instrument containing a magnetized pointer that shows the direction of magnetic north
We used a compass to navigate through the forest.

a bird of prey
A falcon soared high above the mountains.

a fence or boundary formed by closely growing bushes or shrubs
The house was surrounded by a tall hedge.

a feeling of envy towards someone's possessions or qualities
Her jealousy made her act irrationally.

a person who is fond of joking; a playing card
He's always the joker of the group.

an arm or leg of a person or animal; a large branch of a tree
He broke a limb playing football.

a quick downward and upward movement of the head
She gave a nod of approval.

a reddish-brown coating on iron
The old car was covered in rust.

the plot of a story
The movie has a very complex storyline.

a loved one; a kind person
Come here, sweetheart, I have something for you.

a portable light
We used a torch to find our way in the dark.

a soft, low sound
I heard a faint whisper from the next room.

a light, silvery-grey metal
Many modern airplanes are made from aluminium.

a place with coin-operated games
We spent the afternoon at the video game arcade.

hose
He used the garden hose to water the plants.

lava
The volcano erupted, sending hot lava down its sides.

magnet
A magnet can attract metal objects.

a seat for a rider on a horse or bicycle
He put the saddle on the horse.

education received at school
His early schooling prepared him for university.

the part of the human leg between the hip and the knee
He injured his thigh playing football.

a climbing plant
Grapes grow on a vine.

the basic monetary unit of Japan
The price is 5000 yen.

a device that holds something firmly or supports it
He wore a knee brace after his injury.

a title or explanation for a picture or illustration
Read the caption under the photo for more details.
